statement: AMD announced major Instinct design wins, including Anthropic committing to deploy up to 2 GW of MI455X GPUs and OpenAI bringing Helios online in Q4 2026.
why: Multi-gigawatt commitments from frontier labs signal strong demand for AMD accelerators and supply diversification away from NVIDIA.

impact.mechanism: Large named design wins expand merchant-GPU demand and broaden the supplier base.

evidence.excerpt: deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs in AMD Helios rackscale solutions

confidence.basis: Primary vendor press release naming specific customer commitments.
